This candidate reduces POST-IMAGE-EDITOR through common CreatePostRoot media edit anchors and shared selected preview semantics. Android exercises the real QuataImageEditorDialog from the common composer and saves back to the common preview. Web/Wasm and iOS use explicit local opt-in edit adapters to validate the shared action and state roundtrip without backend mutation while native full crop/export parity remains documented as a limit.

The unit also fixes selected media preview accessibility by exposing common contentDescription anchors for image and video previews, because iOS XCTest does not reliably observe non-interactive Compose testTags as accessibility identifiers.
